summary: Iteration 2 testing for new NF-e features (real SEFAZ transmission stub, DANFE QR+protocolo, CC-e endpoint, and fiscal reports). Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 6 new tests (reports JSON, reports JSON date filter incl. empty range, reports CSV export, CC-e validation on non-authorized invoice, CC-e status precedence over text length, PDF still generates after emit). Total 20/20 backend tests pass. Frontend Playwright verified: login -> Relatorios page load -> date range Aplicar -> 3 rows rendered -> Exportar CSV download triggers file 'relatorio-nfe.csv'; invoice detail for pendente invoice shows chave_acesso, invoice-motivo about certificate, download-pdf-button and cce-button; CC-e dialog opens, submits with 15+ char text and correctly surfaces backend 400 'A CC-e so pode ser emitida para notas autorizadas'. All expected/correct behaviors given no A1 cert is configured in this env.

issues: cce-button is shown for status 'pendente' but backend only allows 'autorizada'. Consider hiding CC-e for non-autorizada or showing helper text. Currently error toast handles it correctly.
Radix DialogContent console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Add DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: (Optional) Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to CC-e Dialog to remove Radix warning.
(Optional) Restrict CC-e button visibility to status === 'autorizada' only, matching backend validation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py carta_correcao: input validation order (status check first, then length) is fine and matches request contract.
reports/export.csv uses ';' delimiter and utf-8-sig BOM - correct for Brazilian Excel.
_reports_data does not use MongoDB $gte/$lte; it fetches up to 5000 invoices and filters in Python. For MVP OK; consider server-side filter for scale.
nfe_utils.transmitir_sefaz uses verify=False and urllib3.disable_warnings - acceptable for SEFAZ (self-signed chain), but should ideally load SEFAZ CA bundle in production.
gerar_danfe_pdf embeds QR (build_qrcode_url) using consulta publica URL per UF - correct schema; the fallback to national URL is a good safety net.
build_evento_cce uses UTC time with fixed '-03:00' suffix which is inconsistent (mixes UTC value with BRT offset). Should convert to America/Sao_Paulo before formatting.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped TEST_ prefixed client (deleted), product (deleted). Two additional invoices created and left in DB (pendente/rascunho); one canceled during cancel test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now covers 20 tests including reports JSON, reports CSV, CC-e validation. Real SEFAZ transmission cannot be exercised without A1 .pfx cert in env; emit therefore returns status='pendente' with informative motivo (expected). PDF DANFE includes QR (visual verify via /api/invoices/{id}/pdf).
